description: Validates monetization trust boundaries, declarations, and local metering posture.

notApplicableKinds.reason: This provider requires scenario monetization declarations and local metering posture; the control plane has no product monetization contract.

determinism.reason: The provider scans scenario source and manifest state.

levels.name: Inventory unavailable
exit_criteria: Source and declaration surfaces are readable.

levels.name: Trust boundary
levels.description: The static trust-boundary checks run and findings are visible.
exit_criteria: No shared service secret or symmetric verifier is present.

levels.name: Declared
levels.description: The monetization surface is declared and enforcement paths are inspectable.
exit_criteria: Manifest and enforcement paths are present.

levels.name: Hardened
levels.description: Class A and Class B meters have the required server or durable-local posture.

levels.name: Complete
levels.description: The scenario is ready for monetization assurance.

levels.name: Unsafe
levels.next_unlock: Remove shared secrets and symmetric verification.

levels.name: Governed
levels.capability_summary: A scenario has a declared, server-authoritative monetization boundary with clean trust-boundary checks.
levels.next_unlock: Complete the declared meter, offline, and live-catalog checks.

levels.name: Hardened
levels.description: Meters and offline behavior have the required posture.
entry_criteria: Declaration and enforcement paths are valid.
exit_criteria: Class A and Class B meter checks pass.

levels.name: Complete
levels.description: The monetization surface is ready for assurance.
entry_criteria: All static and live checks pass.
exit_criteria: Live reconciliation and behavioral evidence are available.
levels.capability_summary: The declared monetization boundary is live-reconciled and behaviorally evidenced across desktop and service surfaces.
levels.next_unlock: Keep the declaration and implementation synchronized.

money.undeclared_monetization.reason: Add or repair the governed monetization declaration.

money.service_token_in_client_bundle.reason: Remove shared service credentials from desktop and client surfaces.

money.feature_not_enforced.reason: Declare and implement the authoritative feature enforcement path.

money.meter_missing_tier_limits.reason: Declare and implement the authoritative meter limits.

money.identity_from_request_body.reason: Derive identity from the verified access-token claims.

money.cost_bearing_meter_client_executed.reason: Move cost-bearing work behind the LPBS wallet boundary.

money.limits_from_local_config.reason: Remove duplicated numeric limits from local configuration.

money.gate_blocks_offline.reason: Use a still-valid cached lease during transient outages.

money.no_outbox_for_local_meter.reason: Persist Class B usage in a durable outbox before delivery.

money.unknown_bundle_key.reason: Use the LPBS runtime bundle key.

money.unregistered_app_key.reason: Register the declared app through the delivery catalog.

money.live_catalog_unavailable.reason: Restore the LPBS database/catalog authority before declaring conformance.

money.no_account_surface.reason: Declare and expose the account surface for an entitled scenario.

money.no_journey_probe.reason: Declare and expose a provider-neutral monetization journey probe.
